title: Surreal Cosmic Wanderer
description: A towering purple multi-eyed humanoid figure with multiple faces on its torso holds a bowl containing two fish. In the background, a large red moon with a black eye disintegrates into geometric shapes and purple flowers over a lavender field and mountains, while a small backpacker with a staff stands on a path in the foreground looking up.
prompt: Surreal ink and watercolor painting of a giant purple humanoid with three vertical eyes on its head and multiple screaming faces on its torso, holding a bowl with two orange fish. A large red moon with a black eye is disintegrating into geometric shards and purple flowers raining down over stylized mountain range and lavender fields. Small lone backpacker with staff stands on a path in foreground looking up, detailed linework, mystical atmosphere
